# garage_admin_token (Resource)

Manages a Garage admin API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "garage_admin_token" "deploy" {
  name  = "deploy-token"
  scope = ["GetClusterStatus", "GetClusterHealth", "ListBuckets"]
}

# Token with full access and expiration
resource "garage_admin_token" "admin" {
  name       = "full-admin"
  scope      = ["*"]
  expiration = "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the admin token.
- `scope` (List of String) List of allowed admin API endpoint names, or ["*"] for all.

### Optional

- `expiration` (String) Expiration date (RFC 3339). Mutually exclusive with never_expires.
- `never_expires` (Boolean) Set to true to make the token never expire.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Token creation timestamp.
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether the token has expired.
- `id` (String) Admin token identifier.
- `secret_token` (String, Sensitive) The secret bearer token. Only available at creation time.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Note: secret_token will not be available after import.
terraform import garage_admin_token.deploy <token-id>
```
